newsitem.title: GERMANY: Vereinsbank sees steady loan risk provisions in 97.
newsitem.headline: Vereinsbank sees steady loan risk provisions in 97.

text.p: Germany's Bayerische Vereinsbank AG on Thursday said it expected its provisions for lending risks to remain stable this year while trading profits should increase.
In its interim earnings report, the bank also said it expected its net interest income to rise further in 1997 while commission income should maintain the previous year's high growth rates.
"Risk provisions in lending business will be in our estimation at roughly year-ago levels at the end of the year," Vereinsbank said.
